usage: Level-up spell list for the listed classes. Combat runs it only when a wired ability has the same id.

srd.line: Level 2 Abjuration (Bard, Cleric, Druid, Paladin, Ranger)
srd.text:
_Level 2 Abjuration (Bard, Cleric, Druid, Paladin, Ranger)_

**Casting Time:** Bonus Action
**Range:** Touch
**Components:** V, S
**Duration:** Instantaneous

You touch a creature and end one condition on it: Blinded, Deafened, Paralyzed, or Poisoned.
